name: resistance band side plank
description: A side plank with a band around the legs to fire up the hips and the sides of the waist.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
